title: Product Packshot Photos for Multiple Views | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one photo per side into clean packshots of the front, back, top and base. AI multi-angle product photos for galleries and paid social ads.
h1: Product Packshot Photos for Every Side You Photographed
lead: Open a packshot scene, add one photo of each real side, and download square views you can also turn into a spoken product video.

steps.d: Upload one photo for each side, with the whole item in frame. A real photo of that side keeps ports, handles and corners accurate.
Name the view and one backdrop, then reuse that wording. Add a script and an AI voice if you make an ad.
Download each view and check ports against your photos. Add captions if you turn a view into a video.

faq.q: What is a multi-angle packshot template?
faq.a: A ready scene for the sides you photographed. It can also add an AI actor, a voiceover, and a script when that still should become a short ad.

faq.q: How do I make product packshot photos of every side?
faq.a: Upload one photo of each side, name one shared backdrop, and download the square set. Put the front first, then the sides that show ports, buttons, or the base.

faq.q: Can one photo show a port that was hidden?
faq.a: No. Photograph that side and upload it. A generated view is not a reliable way to reveal a connector, latch, or control that was never in frame.
Electronics shops, listing managers, and agencies that need front, back, and detail views, plus a spoken clip when the ad needs one. A person on screen is an AI performer.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear photo of each side. You do not need a turntable. Captions, a track from the music library, and an AI voice can be set in the built-in editor if you make a video too.

faq.q: Which shops can use these views?
faq.a: Any product with sides shoppers ask about, including chargers, audio, and cameras. Open another scene when the product is not electronics.
Use a JPG, PNG, or WebP that shows the whole product. You can also upload a short clip you have rights to when the ad needs motion you already filmed.

faq.q: Where can I publish the file?
faq.a: Each photo download is square. A video from the same photos can be 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Publish it to TikTok or Meta, or to YouTube, in one step.

faq.q: What does each angle photo cost?
faq.a: Each product photo costs 24 credits. A video is 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can I run these files in ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and can be used in your listings and your own paid ads. Compare the controls with the source before you launch.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link or a batch?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page link for a script, an AI actor, and a cloned voice, or send several products through the AIVideosUGC API. The photos still have to show the sides you claim.
